column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a way blameless” is rendered “the blameless way.”
“The doing of swerving deeds” is rendered “the work of those who fall away,” and “it will not cling to me” as “It shall not fasten its grip on me.”
“The haughty of eyes and the wide of heart” is rendered “a haughty look and an arrogant heart,” and “I will not be able” as “will I endure.”
Close to the Hebrew; “serve” is rendered “minister to.”
Close to the Hebrew; “he will not be established before my eyes” is rendered “shall not maintain his position before me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to the mornings” is rendered “Every morning.”
